scenes.headline: How Motif 2.6B rebuilt the small-model block
scenes.sub: Differential attention and PolyNorm, trained together on 2.5T tokens.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Otter! Motif 2.6B is a small model that swaps two parts of the usual transformer block for ideas that mostly live in papers. Here's how they work.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Keep the dense pre-norm skeleton, but make attention subtract its own noise and make the activation a learned polynomial.
scenes.say: Keep the plain pre-norm skeleton. But make attention subtract its own noise, and make the activation a curve the model learns.

scenes.title: Differential attention
scenes.say: Ordinary attention leaks: some weight lands on tokens that have nothing to do with the query. So each head computes two maps.

parts.note: the usual attention map, signal plus noise
parts.say: The first is the usual map, signal plus noise.

parts.note: a second map, trained to model the noise
parts.say: The second is trained to model the noise.

parts.note: how much of the noise map to subtract
parts.say: Subtract a scaled copy, and the noise cancels, like noise-cancelling headphones. A group norm keeps it stable.

left.title: A fixed activation
items: One curve for the whole network
left.say: A normal network commits to one fixed activation curve.

right.title: PolyNorm
items: A learned polynomial of x, x² and x³
Each power normalized, so x³ can't explode
Every layer bends its own curve
right.say: PolyNorm learns a blend of x, x squared and x cubed, each normalized so the cube can't blow up. Every layer bends its own curve.

scenes.title: A schedule for the data, too

items.say: Training starts broad and web-heavy, to teach general language.
Then eight domain groups slide linearly toward a new mix.
The last tokens pour into code, math, reasoning and Korean.
And every eight billion tokens, the six latest checkpoints are averaged and fed back in.

scenes.title: HumanEval, 0-shot pass@1
scenes.note: on MMLU it trails the 7-8B models
scenes.say: On code, it lands within a few points of Llama 3 8B, and more than doubles Mistral 7B. On MMLU, it trails the bigger models.

scenes.text: Reasoning and code you can train in with architecture and data. Raw knowledge still scales with size.
scenes.say: Reasoning and code, you can train in with architecture and data. Raw knowledge still scales with size.

recap: A data mix that swings toward skills
scenes.say: To recap: attention that cancels its noise, an activation that learns its shape, and data that ends on skills.
